title: System
intro: The router's own identity: host name, time zone, the banners shown before and after login, and the name servers the router itself uses. Save to the candidate, then commit with the pending-change bar.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.help: RFC 1123 host name, e.g. vrx-a or vrx-a.lab.example

login.title: Pre-login banner
login.help: Shown before authentication (console, SSH and the web login page). Printable text, line breaks and tabs only.

servers.title: Name servers
servers.help: Up to 8 IP addresses, in order.

vrf.title: VRF
vrf.help: This agent build supports the default VRF only.

live.title: Candidate and running
live.note: Running is the committed configuration the agent applies. A name server change takes effect when systemd-resolved restarts.

observed.title: Observed system state
observed.note: Runtime-file observation does not prove resolver health or that a pending restart has occurred. Slot agents observe only their installed configuration.
